title: SLAS 2026 Sample Management Symposium
content: SLAS 2026 Sample Management Symposium --> --> October 21-22, 2026 Genentech South San Francisco, CA, USA Register SLAS 2026 Sample Management Symposium Genentech 401 DNA Way Building 21 South San Francisco, CA 94080 Register Today – the SLAS 2026 Sample Management Symposium hosted at Genentech will bring together sample managers and technology providers to discuss best practices, digital innovation, current trends and topics related to the expansion and demands of research facilities, including biospecimens, data analysis and more. Each year’s symposium program is unique and will address current topics and challenges. What You Can Expect 5 Scientific Sessions : Explore the latest advancements in sample management through expert-led presentations that inform, educate and deliver practical solutions. 14 Exhibitors : Engage with industry-leading technology providers showcasing their innovative solutions. Technology Snapshots : Concise, insightful technology demonstrations and solutions relevant to your needs. Networking that Matters : Build valuable connections and collaborations within the sample management community. Register today to secure your spot at the best rate Register Now View the full schedule Schedule at a Glance Important Dates and Deadlines Call for Abstracts Opens: Monday, November 3, 2025 Sponsorship Prospectus Available: Monday, November 3, 2025 Early Registration Rate Ends: Wednesday, September 9, 2026 Podium and Poster Abstract Submission Deadline: Monday, September 7, 2026 Science, Strategy and Solutions Five scientific sessions will address the most pressing challenges and opportunities in sample management today. From integrating AI and automation to building robust ecosystems for multiple modalities, each session delivers actionable insights you can apply directly to your work. Subject matter experts will present strategies for modernizing your infrastructure, adopting best practices from other industries, and future-proofing your operations against unexpected disruptions. These sessions are valuable because they’re not strictly theoretical—they’re practical. Each session will provide you with the knowledge to boost efficiency, enhance data integrity, and accelerate discovery in an increasingly complex research landscape. Attending will empower you not just to keep pace with change, but to lead it within your own organization. Select a session below for information, including: topic description, subtopics and current speakers. The Intelligent Lab: AI and Automation Driving Next-Generation Sample Management Building a Sample Management Ecosystem for Multiple Modalities Infrastructure and Informatics: The Modern Backbone of Discovery Lessons from Beyond Traditional Sample Management Resilience by Design: Future Proofing Sample Management Operations View All Sessions Session Previews Have you ever wondered what goes into planning a session?
